question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        interest_id,
        MAX(composition) AS max_composition
    FROM interest_metrics
    WHERE composition IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY interest_id
),
top10_ids AS (
    SELECT interest_id, max_composition
    FROM max_composition
    ORDER BY max_composition DESC
    LIMIT 10
),
bottom10_ids AS (
    SELECT interest_id, max_composition
    FROM max_composition
    ORDER BY max_composition ASC
    LIMIT 10
)
SELECT 
    im2.month_year AS time,
    im.interest_name,
    t.max_composition AS composition
FROM top10_ids t
JOIN interest_metrics im2 ON im2.interest_id = t.interest_id AND im2.composition = t.max_composition
JOIN interest_map im ON im.id = im2.interest_id
UNION ALL
SELECT 
    im2.month_year AS time,
    im.interest_name,
    b.max_composition AS composition
FROM bottom10_ids b
JOIN interest_metrics im2 ON im2.interest_id = b.interest_id AND im2.composition = b.max_composition
JOIN interest_map im ON im.id = im2.interest_id
